summary_en: This study compares nemtabrutinib plus venetoclax with venetoclax plus rituximab in adults with relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma. Nemtabrutinib and venetoclax are given as daily oral tablets in 4-week cycles, with venetoclax starting at Cycle 2 Day 1, for up to 2 years or until progression or discontinuation. The main outcome is progression-free survival by iwCLL 2018 criteria, as assessed by blinded independent central review.
summary_es: Este estudio compara nemtabrutinib más venetoclax con venetoclax más rituximab en adultos con leucemia linfocítica crónica o linfoma linfocítico de pequeñas células recidivante o refractario. Nemtabrutinib y venetoclax se administran como tabletas orales diarias en ciclos de 4 semanas, y el venetoclax comienza en el Ciclo 2 Día 1, durante hasta 2 años o hasta la progresión o la suspensión. El resultado principal es la supervivencia libre de progresión según los criterios iwCLL 2018, evaluada por revisión central independiente y ciega.
who_for: Confirmed CLL or SLL with active disease that is clearly documented as needing treatment.
Relapsed or refractory after at least 1 prior available therapy.
Has at least 1 marker of disease burden.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2 and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Able to swallow and retain oral medication.
not_for: Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C virus infection.
Richter transformation or active central nervous system involvement by CLL/SLL.
Another malignancy that is progressing or needed active treatment within the past 2 years.
Prior BCL2 inhibitor within 12 months before randomization.
